raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: wannier90io
  version: 0.1.0b1

package:
  name: ${{ name|lower }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/${{ name[0] }}/${{ name }}/wannier90io-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 7b43d0cdcfdca5f3a0ce67b8605fde13c0afbfefb2319bae2f192b2189732c7d

build:
  number: 3
  noarch: python
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation
  python:
    entry_points:
      - w90io = wannier90io.__main__:main

requirements:
  host:
    - python ${{ python_min }}.*
    - hatchling
    - pip
  run:
    - python >=${{ python_min }}
    - numpy
    - pydantic

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - wannier90io
      pip_check: true
      python_version:
        - ${{ python_min }}
        - "*"
  - requirements:
      run:
        - pip
        - python ${{ python_min }}.*
    script:
      - w90io --help

about:
  summary: A Python library for Wannier90 I/O
  license: MIT
  license_file: LICENSE
  homepage: https://github.com/jimustafa/wannier90io-python

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - jan-janssen
